_about: AUTHORED (T160, Q49 decided 2026-10-23 under the owner's T78 rule: disclose tidal OR backwater influence where the record shows it). Level gauges a LAKE BELOW THEM backs water up into — a STANDING backwater, not the episodic ice, beaver or landslide backwater HYDAT also records (those stay unread). Each row names the lake (`from`) and quotes the HYDAT station remark that says so (`remark`, verbatim, case and spacing aside); pipeline/gauges/consume/tidal.py refuses a row whose quote is not in the station's own STN_REMARKS or does not name the lake, and a station also flagged tidal. The bundle writes gauge.backwater = 1; the app says one sentence in the Level view.

08HB074.remark: STATION SUBJECT TO VARIABLE BACKWATER FROM COMOX LAKE, NECESSITATING EXTENSIVE ESTIMATED PERIODS
08HB074.why: Cruickshank River near the mouth: the gauge sits where the river enters Comox Lake, and HYDAT's station remark (type 4, standing; repeated in the 2003-2010 annual remarks) says the lake's level backs up onto it.
